VariantCalling.BcftoolsCall.commandLine:
set -euo pipefail
# pile the alignments and their indexes back into one directory
mkdir -p alignments
for bam in /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/230049286/A.sorted.bam /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/-1566902073/B.sorted.bam /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/931113864/C.sorted.bam; do ln -s "$bam" alignments/; done
for bai in /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/-1581987200/A.sorted.bam.bai /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/916028737/B.sorted.bam.bai /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/-880922622/C.sorted.bam.bai; do ln -s "$bai" alignments/; done

bcftools mpileup -d 250 -a AD,DP -f /home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-BcftoolsCall/inputs/1495863733/genome.fa alignments/*.bam \

VariantCalling.PlotQuals.commandLine:
set -euo pipefail
python3 <<'PYTHON'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pysam import VariantFile

quals = [record.qual for record in VariantFile("/home/oj/fairscape/fairscape_conversion/examples/wdl-variant-calling/cromwell-executions/VariantCalling/c7066cd6-5dd5-434d-b0f5-fca0662f2533/call-PlotQuals/inputs/1301869358/all.vcf")]

figure, axes = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
axes.hist(quals, bins=30, color="#3b6ea5", edgecolor="white")
axes.set_xlabel("variant quality (Phred)")
axes.set_ylabel("variants")
axes.set_title(f"{len(quals)} variants called across all samples")
figure.tight_layout()
figure.savefig("quals.svg")
PYTHON
